visual_action: The video opens with a short clip of Donald Trump speaking at a podium in front of American flags. It then cuts to a still image of Trump on a golf course, wearing a red 'MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN' hat. This image is covered with numerous text overlays listing various criticisms of his presidency.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is shown in a speaking clip and a still photograph, and is the subject of all the critical on-screen text.

cast.name: Supreme Court
cast.evidence: On-screen text mentions 'Appointed conservative Supreme Court justices'.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of a song with female vocals singing lyrics including 'Don't forget me.'
audio_music: A slow, melodic, and somewhat somber pop song with female vocals plays throughout the video. The lyrics align with the on-screen text 'don't forget.'
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single cut from a brief video clip to a static image that is heavily overlaid with text.
central_claim: Voters should not forget the numerous negative policies and outcomes of Donald Trump's presidency.
intended_effect: To remind viewers of actions taken during the Trump administration that the creator views as negative, in order to discourage them from supporting him in the future.
